text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the training menu
for my debut race...?
Wondering what I could do for Win Variation, I put together a phased training routine leading up to her debut race.

Assessing what she needs based on her current condition,
I set daily goals for her so we can take things step by step.

By the target date, my body should be in shape
to put up good results... hopefully.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible... So this is what having a "Trainer" means...

"She's already the type to worry constantly about everything.
I wanted to ease her emotional burden as much as I could."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
I'm sorry for making you worry so much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Understood. When it comes to training,
I'll gladly rely on you plenty.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"All I gotta do is run and run and—
beat that girl! That's all!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Thinking of it that way puts my mind at ease!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'll do my absolute best!

And from that day on, I worked hard training
alongside Win Variation—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
...H-How was my time?"
choice_data_list: So close! Just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
I really don't have enough stamina, huh.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, haah...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, your body is getting used to it! Keep at it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes! Off I go for one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: Just a bit more! Focus on the muscles you're using!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes!
Alright, mind on the muscles, mind on the muscles—!"
――Soon came the long-awaited day of her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...*sigh*...
Phew... Focus, I need to focus...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... It's no use.
Maybe doing some stretches will calm me down...

Seeing that she wasn't fully focused, I felt relieved that I had made arrangements in advance.
...The truth is, just in case, I had called over a certain person.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text: Hello, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: D-Dad?! How come you're here...!

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how Shion was doing,
so I just came by to say hello for a bit.

He gave me a subtle wink, and I gave him a small nod in return.
Yes, that "certain person" was her father.

Knowing her personality, she might get overly worked up for her debut race.
I had reached out beforehand, asking if they could offer her some words of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You didn't have to... You really shouldn't have gone out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
You look awfully nervous to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's... yeah, it is.
...I was just wondering if I could pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! 
I see, I understand. But it's alright.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text: You've worked hard all this time, haven't you? All for this very day.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I've worked hard. I've done
so much training together with Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You gave me so much encouragement and guidance,
which is why I was able to try my absolute hardest.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text: Then you'll be fine. Hard work never betrays you. It has surely nourished Shion's growth.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text: So go out there and run with your head held high.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Father.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Alright, alright!
It's fine, it's gonna be fine! I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!
Her father's gentle yet empowering words gave her a firm push forward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Well then, I'm off—wait, before that.
Trainer, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My dad is a busy man, so it must have been tough
to fit into his schedule... Thank you so much
for taking the trouble to contact and invite him.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my nerves are gone.
I feel like I can really bring out my full strength now!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Take care, have a safe trip!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm off...!

With steady, confident steps,
she dashed off toward the paddock.
And so, her debut race began!
